title: In-context learning from self-generated trajectories for adaptive model reduction
abstract: arXiv:2607.02937v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: High-fidelity simulations of complex physical systems are often too expensive for repeated prediction, design, and control. Reduced-order models address this computational cost by compressing high-dimensional dynamics into low-dimensional representations that can be evaluated rapidly, but they often lose accuracy when online dynamics drift beyond the offline training data. Adaptive methods address this limitation by updating the reduced subspace online using external, out-of-span information, such as full-order corrections or sensor snapshots. We discovered that a complementary and previously unexploited in-span adaptation channel exists within the current reduced subspace. translated_title: 基于自生成轨迹的上下文学习用于自适应模型降阶
translated_abstract: 复杂物理系统的高保真仿真对于重复预测、设计和控制而言往往代价过于高昂。降阶模型通过将高维动力学压缩为可快速计算的低维表示来解决这一计算成本问题，但当在线动力学漂移超出离线训练数据范围时，其精度往往会下降。自适应方法通过利用外部的、超出张成空间的信息（如全阶修正或传感器快照）在线更新降阶子空间来应对这一局限。我们发现，在当前降阶子空间内部存在一条互补的、此前未被利用的张成空间内自适应通道。为了利用这一通道，我们通过带遗忘因子的增量奇异值分解，利用模型自身的预测来持续更新降阶表示。这产生了一种由轨迹信息驱动的谱预条件器，其中可约……
tldr: 该论文发现降阶子空间内部存在一条此前未被利用的自适应通道，并提出利用模型自身生成的预测轨迹，通过带遗忘因子的增量奇异值分解持续更新降阶表示，从而实现自适应模型降阶。
en_tdlr: The paper discovers a previously unexploited in-span adaptation channel within the reduced subspace and proposes continually updating the reduced representation using the model's own self-generated trajectories via incremental SVD with a forgetting factor, enabling adaptive model reduction.
